result.title: FewStepRL: Fine-tuning Few-step Diffusion Models with Reinforcement Learning
result.summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) has become a standard post-training method for diffusion models, but most RL objectives roll out the current policy at every iteration, and with a many-step sampler these rollouts typically dominate the cost of training. Few-step models cut this cost, yet they model an average velocity over an interval, whereas existing RL objectives are built for an instantaneous velocity with a many-step sampler. We adapt RL objectives to few-step models systematically in three phases, namely a transformation, a decomposition and an adaptation. The transformation to $x$-space expresses each objective we consider through a common policy prediction, at the clean end by default and at an explicitly marked level for transition or flow-map objectives, so that objectives stated over densities, velocities or rewards become comparable. The decomposition writes the gradient of each of these objectives as the sum of a self-regression toward a reference and a reward augmentation, so that a method reduces, at the gradient level, to a choice of anchors and weights. The adaptation computes each anchor from a few-step model at the end of its transport or along its tangent, with the instantaneous velocity recovered from the network itself or from an auxiliary network. This yields few-step versions of FlowGRPO, AWM, DiffusionNFT, DiffusionOPSD and ReFL in one modular codebase. In our experiments, reward-gradient-based methods are the most effective when the reward is differentiable and its gradient is affordable; otherwise DiffusionNFT-style methods generally reach high rewards in relatively few iterations despite a sometimes higher per-iteration cost. Extra inference steps show no systematic aggregate benefit in our experiments, although selected outputs visibly improve with two to four times as many sampling steps as in training.

AI.brief_summary: 该技术报告系统地把扩散模型的 RL 目标迁移到 few-step 模型：先在 x 空间统一各类目标，再把梯度分解为「指向参考的自回归项 + 奖励增强项」，并按 few-step 模型的传输终点或切线计算锚点，从而在一个模块化代码库中给出 FlowGRPO、AWM、DiffusionNFT 等的少步版本并比较效果。
AI.relevance_reason: 其将奖励目标拆为参考锚定项与奖励项的梯度视角，以及「锚点取在轨迹何处」的选择，可能可供核查 latent 推理轨迹训练的监督锚定与贡献分配；但研究对象是图像生成的少步采样，未涉及视觉推理状态，需人工判断可迁移性。
